bar.savedDropped: Raid plan saved. {count} assignment(s) to players no longer in the setup were removed.

conflict.text: Someone changed the raid plan in the meantime. Your changes are still here, but you can only save after reloading.

noInstance.title: No instance is set for this event.
noInstance.text: The raid plan makes one board for every boss of the chosen instance. Pick the instance under "Manage event" → Edit.

setupHint.none: There is no setup yet. Without a setup there are no players to place.
setupHint.notApproved: The setup is not approved yet. You can plan already, but the read view only names players once the setup is approved.

board.noMapText: Upload a boss room map, it will sit behind the players.
board.mapHelp: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 3 MB. A boss without a map of its own uses its instance's map.
board.mapTooBig: The image is larger than 3 MB.
board.mapRemoveText: The map is deleted. Plans stay, they show the grid instead.
board.hint: Drag elements from the palette and players from the list onto the board or onto a slot. Right click (touch: long press) opens the menu, a double click the properties, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes.
board.hintTemplate: Drag elements from the palette onto the board, or click them. Right click (touch: long press) opens the menu, a double click the properties, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes.
board.mapResetText: This map is deleted, the board shows the template's map or the default map again.
board.mapCannotShrink: The image cannot be brought under 3 MB. Use a smaller or less detailed picture.
board.mapNotImage: Only PNG, JPG or WebP are allowed (no GIF, SVG or anything else).
board.mapUnreadable: The file cannot be read as an image.

tray.title: Not placed
tray.empty: Every player is on the board.

targets.title: Tasks
targets.empty: No rows yet. Add one or pick a tactic.
targets.rowsFull: More than {max} rows are not possible.

profile.label: Tactic
profile.empty: There is no tactic for this boss yet. Create rows and save them as a tactic.
profile.applyText: This boss's rows and note are replaced by those of the tactic. Players assigned to a row keep it when the title stays the same.
profile.saveHint: The rows (titles only) and the note are saved, no players.
profile.name: Name
profile.categoryPlaceholder: Pick a category or type a new one
profile.needRows: Add at least one row first.
profile.deleteText: Rows already applied in plans stay, only the template goes away.
profile.manageHint: Changing a tactic does not change rows that were already applied.

share.title: Publish the raid plan
share.text: Once published, anyone with the link can read the plan without logging in. Whoever logs in sees their own token highlighted.
share.unpublished: The plan was withdrawn, the link no longer answers.
share.unsavedHint: There are unsaved changes. What is saved is what gets published.
share.noSetup: The setup is not approved yet, so the read view has no players.

public.notFound: This raid plan does not exist (any more).
public.empty: Nothing is planned for this event yet.
public.you: You are in the plan for this boss.
public.youNot: You are not in the plan for this boss.
public.loginHint: Log in and your spot is highlighted.

slot.openTip: Slots without a player: nobody in the setup had a fitting role, or you left them open.
slot.groupHint: A group marker names the players of the setup group with this number.
slot.allPlaced: All {what} are on the map already. New slots only come from + / - in the roster slots.

zone.label: Label
zone.patternHint: The type is also shown as a symbol and a label inside the zone, not by colour alone.

add.title: Add object
add.hint: It appears in the middle, drag it away.
add.label: Add label

selection.hint: Arrow keys move, Delete removes, Enter opens the details.

template.hint: Copies the template into this plan. Later changes to the template do not reach it.
template.noneYet: There is no template yet. Make one under Raid events → Raid plan templates.
template.applyText: The template's bosses replace the boards in this plan, unsaved changes to them are lost. Bosses the template does not have stay.
template.applied: Template "{name}" applied. Open slots are marked on the board.
template.hintEmpty: Tip: "Pick a template" starts you from a template.

tool.label: Tools
tool.bes: Show or hide the roster slots
tool.select: Selection mode (tap adds / removes, rubber band on empty ground)
tool.rings: Show or hide the group rings (all at once)
tool.preview: Read-view preview: how the sheet shows it (no grips or selection)

palette.title: Elements
palette.hint: Drag onto the board or click.
palette.iconUnknown: There is no icon with this name.

insp.none: Nothing selected. Click an object on the board or in the layer list, or drag something from the elements onto the board.
insp.splitHint: Hidden, the marker shows only its tag. Split, the raiders of the setup group stand around it as tokens.
insp.memberHint: A raider of a split group. Dragging moves only him (his place is kept relative to the marker), the size is his alone.
insp.relativeHint: One factor for everything selected (100 % = unchanged).

icon.label: Label
icon.facingHint: Drag the handle above the icon to turn it (Shift = 15° steps), Q / E turn by 15°.

assign.title: Assignments
assign.suggestTip: Creates rows from the setup. They are marked as a suggestion and can be changed.
assign.textTarget: Free text, e.g. an ability or an enemy
assign.noSuggestion: No suggestion possible: nobody in the setup fits.
assign.empty: Nothing yet. Add a row or get a suggestion.
assign.removeCardText: {count} rows of this card are deleted. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
assign.outOfClass: Not the preferred class of this assignment
assign.cardEmptyHeal: No row yet. Give healers tanks, groups or players.

bes.title: Roster slots
bes.tip: The role slots of this raid ({size} players). Assignments do not need a place on the map.
bes.placeTip: Drag onto the map or click
bes.flexNote: In the setup: {role}. Only for this boss.
bes.ownTip: These numbers only apply to this boss.
bes.reset: Back to the raid type's numbers

mobs.title: Mobs
mobs.tip: Everything that can be tanked or marked in this section: the boss, its adds from the catalog and the mobs you add. They are always available as a tank target in the assignments.
mobs.onMap: Put {name} on the map as an icon

am.classHint: Suggestions take these classes first. If nobody fits the row stays empty, unless you allow others.
am.bind: Bind the class to the slots
am.bindTip: The chosen classes then apply to this row's slots (e.g. DPS 3 = Rogue)

split.label: Map height
split.tip: Drag: make the map bigger or smaller (arrow up/down)

read.notInPlan: No assignment for you in this section.
read.loginHint: Log in to see your tasks and what is assigned to you.
read.onlyMineTip: Only the sections and tasks that concern you

multi.skipped: {n} object(s) skipped: slots of the roster and players are not copied.
multi.hint: Drag moves all, Del deletes all, +/- and the corner grips scale, Ctrl+D duplicates, Esc clears. One Ctrl+Z undoes the whole action.

defaults.title: Default
defaults.inheritedTip: Inherited from the template's default. A change of the default reaches every boss that does not deviate.
defaults.deviate: Deviate for this boss (the row becomes boss specific)
defaults.restore: Restore the default (reset the deviations of this card)
defaults.copy: Apply the default to all bosses (copy)
defaults.copyTip: Writes the rows into every boss that does not deviate
defaults.copyTitle: Copy the default into all bosses?
defaults.copyText: The {count} rows of the default are written as own rows into every boss that does not deviate yet. Bosses with a deviation stay untouched. One Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
defaults.copyEmpty: The default has no rows yet.
defaults.explain: The default is the basic tank and healer set-up every boss and trash section takes over (“Tank 1 -> Boss” shows each boss's own boss). A boss can deviate or hide a row. “General” is something else: raid-wide utility such as curses, once for the whole raid.

roster.title: Assign the roster
roster.hint: Pick a slot, then click a player or drag him onto a slot. Whoever stands elsewhere swaps places.
roster.wishHint: When the template is applied the slot gets a player of this class; without one in the raid it stays open.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.text: The raid plan could not be shown. Your saved data is not affected.

class.title: Class (filled automatically)
class.allowMulti: Allow several (the same player may do it more than once)

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.fit: Fit (as the read view shows it)
zoom.hand: Hand: move the picture (or hold Space / middle mouse button)
zoom.actualTip: One screen pixel per unit (the picture at its reference size)
zoom.saveView: Save this cut-out as the default (the read view opens with it)
zoom.minimap: Overview: click or drag to move the cut-out
zoom.pan: Move the picture: drag on empty ground, Space + drag, arrow keys. Selection rectangle: Shift + drag.

view.title: Icon size and display
view.iconSizeHint: Tokens, slots, marks, boss icons and their names - also in the read view.
view.forMe: Only for you, remembered in this browser.
view.forPlan: Saved in the plan (also in the read view).
